# SHABABUNA

> SHABABUNA is a bilingual basketball retail, custom design, teams and wholesale platform based in Tripoli, Libya.

Canonical site: https://shababuna.ly
Contact: shababuna.info@gmail.com
Phone / WhatsApp: +218 92 657 8062

Main sections:
- /shop — clothing, footwear, accessories, basketballs and equipment
- /customize — custom product design and quote requests
- /teams-wholesale — clubs, academies, federations, distributors and bulk supply
- /lha-store — official LHA clothing and accessories shop
- /stories — basketball stories and editorial content

Commerce rules:
- Base currency USD; optional LYD conversion uses the Shababuna backend exchange rate.
- Libya delivery is 20 LYD and free from 500 LYD.
- Ready-to-ship delivery inside Libya is 24–72 hours.
- Standard non-ready delivery to Libya is estimated at 14–18 days.
- International shipping is quoted per destination before payment.
- Custom and wholesale timing and payment terms are confirmed in the approved quote for the specific request.
